intentionally_component_empty_sheets.UI_00_ROOT: hierarchy and named sheet interfaces only
intentionally_component_empty_sheets.UI_60_TESTPOINTS_MANUFACTURING: virtual/physical test-point symbols are added with the implemented nets in H2.2.10
intentionally_component_empty_sheets.RF_00_ROOT: hierarchy and named sheet interfaces only
intentionally_component_empty_sheets.RF_60_TESTPOINTS_MANUFACTURING: virtual/physical test-point symbols are added with the implemented nets in H2.3

inventory_binding.rule: Every inventory row has exactly one project, physical-board disposition and owning functional sheet; alternative LoRa modules are distinct assembly variants, not simultaneously fitted parts.

cross_project_contracts.rule: contact number, net name, direction and quiet-state metadata must match exactly in both projects
all 40 contacts remain one-to-one; the adapter may not reinterpret any signal
all 14 host and accessory contacts, power states and TX evidence semantics must match

net_naming.local_unnamed_nets: allowed only for passive implementation nodes that do not cross a sheet or connector
net_naming.reserved_contacts: retain the source name and explicit NC/reserved disposition

sheet_interface_policy.power: named hierarchical pins with source rail name and direction
sheet_interface_policy.digital_bus: named hierarchical pins; clock, data, chip-select and IRQ remain separate
sheet_interface_policy.analog: named source and return; never collapse guarded/differential paths
sheet_interface_policy.rf: named source, reference impedance and connector endpoint; PCB geometry closes later
sheet_interface_policy.safety: permit, evidence, watchdog and FAULT_KILL never hide behind a generic bus
sheet_interface_policy.test: test points are outputs of the owning functional sheet and are collected only on the project test sheet
